preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access the mint function

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) function with the attacker's address as _to and a large amount value. This will mint new tokens directly to the attacker's balance, increasing total supply and diluting existing token holders. The mint function has no cap or limit on the amount that can be minted.
